THE TRUST BOUNDARY

Small commitments.
Inspectable guarantees.

Full content stays off-chain. Ethereum enforces receipt policy and records each batch commitment.

01 / MANDATE

Owner grants scope

Tool allowlist, agent key, total budget, per-call cap, and expiry are stored in the contract.

02 / EXECUTION

Agent signs evidence

The gateway runs a local tool. Its agent key signs the content hashes, cost, and sequence number.

03 / SETTLEMENT

Contract checks policy

Signatures, tool proofs, nonces, limits, and expiry are checked atomically before anchoring a Merkle root.

04 / VERIFICATION

Anyone checks inclusion

A portable bundle links content to its signature and a root retrieved from the expected contract.

What a passing proof means

  • The configured agent key signed the exact receipt.
  • Included content matches its signed hashes.
  • The receipt belongs to a batch accepted by this contract.
  • Contract policy checks passed when the batch settled.

What it does not establish

  • That an AI answer is correct, or a service reported honestly.
  • That the gateway logged every action or prevented external spending.
  • Public-chain finality: this demo uses a single local EVM node.
  • Payments: credits here are a metering unit, with no token transfers.
